text: Read the PMF survey on your card and tell me in three lines what it says about who loves Kindling.

- Solo and pre-Kickstarter designers who dread fight-with-margins print setup and scattered playtest notes love it most.
- Those who say they'd be "very disappointed" without it specifically praise true-to-size home printing and automated thematic feedback sorting.
- With only 11 responses so far, the signal points to indie creators rushing toward playtests or crowdfunding.
